How It Works

Four steps. You see it before you pay for it.

Every project runs the same way — simple, and you stay in control of the call at each step.

  1. 1

    Tell me your idea

    A short conversation about what you want built and who it’s for. That’s all I need to start.

  2. 2

    Free mockup first

    I design a first look at your site so you can see where it’s headed — before you pay anything.

  3. 3

    You approve it

    You say the word, and I build the real thing — then test it on a real phone so it works where your customers actually are.

  4. 4

    It goes live

    Your site goes live at its own web address — your domain if you have one, connected free, or a free address I set up for you — and you get the link, ready to share with the world.

Business Site

$1,499

A typical business website runs $3,000 or more.

For a business that needs the full presence.

  • Everything in Starter Site, plus:

App Build

From $4,999

Lean app builds typically start at $10,000.

For an idea that needs to be an app, not a page.

  • An app designed & built from your idea
  • Screens and branding in your style
  • The features your idea actually needs
  • Tested on a real phone before it’s done
  • You get the finished app build, ready to use
  • Free mockup before you pay

Care Plan

$79/mo

Managed care plans typically run $100–$250 a month.

Keep your site looked after once it’s live.

  • Hosting included for sites I build
  • Up to 2 hours of content updates every month
  • Security and functionality checks every month
  • Backups, and your site kept up to date
  • Priority support — straight to the builder, no ticket queue; replies within one business day
  • A short monthly health summary of your site

Update hours don’t roll over month to month. Updates cover edits to your existing pages — new pages and new features are quoted separately as build work. Your domain name stays yours to buy — I connect it free. Heavy or special hosting setups are quoted separately.
